source.text: שִׁמְע֤וּ אִיִּים֙ אֵלַ֔י וְהַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ לְאֻמִּ֖ים מֵרָח֑וֹק יְהוָה֙ מִבֶּ֣טֶן קְרָאָ֔נִי מִמְּעֵ֥י אִמִּ֖י הִזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen, coastlands, to me, and pay attention, peoples, from afar. Yahweh from [the] womb called me; from [the] inner parts of my mother he made mention of my name.

en.L: Listen, coastlands, to me, \q and pay attention, peoples from afar. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} from the womb called me; \q from the inner parts of my mother {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made mention of my name.
en.B: Coastlands, listen to me; \q peoples who live far away, give heed. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called me while I was still in the womb; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke my name while I was yet inside my mother.
en.R: Listen to me, you lands far away! \q Pay attention, you peoples who live far off! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called me before I was born. \q He said my name while I was still inside my mother.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, costas, \q y {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} atención, pueblos lejanos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me llamó desde el vientre; \q desde las entrañas de mi madre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mencionó mi nombre.
es.B: Costas lejanas, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}; \q pueblos que viven lejos, {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} atención. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me llamó cuando yo aún estaba en el vientre; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pronunció mi nombre cuando yo todavía estaba dentro de mi madre.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, tierras lejanas! \q ¡{{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} atención, pueblos que viven lejos! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me llamó antes de que yo naciera. \q Dijo mi nombre cuando yo todavía estaba dentro de mi madre.

fr.L: Écoutez-moi, îles, \q et soyez attentifs, peuples lointains. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a appelé dès le sein [maternel] ; \q dès les entrailles de ma mère {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mentionné mon nom.
fr.B: Îles lointaines, écoutez-moi ; \q peuples qui vivez au loin, prêtez attention. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a appelé quand j’étais encore dans le sein de ma mère ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prononcé mon nom alors que j’étais encore en elle.
fr.R: Écoutez-moi, pays lointains ! \q Faites attention, peuples qui vivez loin d’ici ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a appelé avant ma naissance. \q Il a dit mon nom quand j’étais encore dans le ventre de ma mère.

sw.L: Nisikilizeni, enyi visiwa, \q mkasikilize, enyi mataifa kutoka mbali. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniita tangu tumboni; \q tangu ndani ya mama yangu alilitaja jina langu.
sw.B: Enyi pwani za mbali, nisikilizeni; \q enyi mataifa mnaoishi mbali, tegeni masikio. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniita nilipokuwa bado tumboni; \q alilitaja jina langu nilipokuwa bado ndani ya mama yangu.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, enyi nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari! \q Sikilizeni kwa makini, enyi mataifa mnaoishi mbali! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniita kabla sijazaliwa. \q Alilitaja jina langu nilipokuwa bado tumboni mwa mama yangu.

decisions.choice: me: the servant speaks
decisions.reason: In 49:1-6 the servant speaks for himself and tells the distant nations how God called and sent him. In 42:1-4 God spoke about the servant; here the servant tells his own story, as he does again in 50:4-9. Who the servant is is discussed at verse 3 and at 41:8.

decisions.choice: called from the womb: chosen for a task before birth
decisions.reason: God says the same of Israel, formed from the womb (44:2, 24), and of Jeremiah, appointed before he was born (Jeremiah 1:5). Paul echoes this line when he speaks of his own call (Galatians 1:15).

decisions.choice: made mention of my name: named me and so claimed me for his purpose
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring to mind or to speak aloud. To speak someone's name is to single that person out and appoint him (43:1; 45:3-4).

decisions.choice: me, mi (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The servant speaks in 49:1-6; his own "me" and "mi" take no deity_pronoun span, as the terms note sets for the servant; God's "él" does.

decisions.choice: the servant speaks in the first person, with no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: In 49:1-6 the servant tells his own call (meaning decision m1). His "mimi", "langu" and "yangu" are plain, and spans stand only on God's possessives, as for the servant in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "Écoutez-moi" (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The speaker here is the servant, so his "moi", "mon", "ma" take no deity_pronoun span, as the English; God's own pronouns in the song keep theirs.

source.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם פִּי֙ כְּחֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֔ה בְּצֵ֥ל יָד֖וֹ הֶחְבִּיאָ֑נִי וַיְשִׂימֵ֨נִי֙ לְחֵ֣ץ בָּר֔וּר בְּאַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ הִסְתִּירָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made my mouth like a sword sharp; in [the] shadow of his hand he hid me; and he made me into an arrow polished; in his quiver he concealed me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made my mouth like a sharp sword; \q in the shadow of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hid me; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made me a polished arrow; \q in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} quiver {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} concealed me.
en.B: He gave me a mouth as sharp as a sword \q and kept me covered in the shade of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q He shaped me into a keen, polished arrow \q and tucked me away in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} quiver.
en.R: He made my words as sharp as a sword. \q He kept me safe under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q He made me like a smooth, sharp arrow \q and kept me hidden in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} quiver, the case that holds arrows.

es.L: E hizo mi boca como espada afilada; \q en la sombra de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano me escondió; \q y me hizo como flecha pulida; \q en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} aljaba me guardó.
es.B: Me dio una boca tan afilada como una espada \q y me tuvo cubierto a la sombra de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q Me convirtió en una flecha aguda y pulida \q y me guardó en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} aljaba.
es.R: Hizo que mis palabras fueran tan cortantes como una espada. \q Me protegió bajo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q Me hizo como una flecha lisa y afilada \q y me tuvo escondido en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} aljaba, el estuche donde se guardan las flechas.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait de ma bouche comme une épée tranchante ; \q dans l’ombre de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a caché ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait de moi une flèche polie ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} carquois {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dissimulé.
fr.B: Il a rendu ma bouche aussi tranchante qu’une épée \q et m’a gardé à couvert à l’ombre de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Il a fait de moi une flèche acérée et polie \q et m’a rangé dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} carquois.
fr.R: Il a rendu mes paroles aussi tranchantes qu’une épée. \q Il m’a protégé sous {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Il a fait de moi comme une flèche lisse et pointue \q et il m’a gardé caché dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} carquois, l’étui où l’on range les flèches.

sw.L: Naye amekifanya kinywa changu kama upanga mkali; \q katika kivuli cha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} amenificha; \q naye amenifanya mshale uliosuguliwa; \q katika podo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} amenisitiri.
sw.B: Alinipa kinywa kikali kama upanga \q na kunifunika katika kivuli cha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Alinifanya mshale mkali uliong'arishwa \q na kunihifadhi katika podo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Aliyafanya maneno yangu kuwa makali kama upanga. \q Alinilinda chini ya mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Alinifanya kama mshale laini, mkali, \q na kunificha ndani ya podo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, mfuko wa kuwekea mishale.

decisions.choice: my mouth like a sharp sword: words that cut and do their work
decisions.reason: The servant's weapon is what he says. The king of 11:4 strikes the earth with the rod of his mouth; Hebrews 4:12 calls God's word sharper than a sword, and Revelation 1:16 pictures a sharp sword coming from the mouth of the risen Christ.

decisions.choice: hidden in the shadow of his hand and in his quiver: protected and kept ready
alternatives: kept out of sight until his time
decisions.reason: Shade is a picture of protection; 51:16 uses the same phrase, "in the shadow of my hand I have covered you". An arrow kept in the quiver is safe and ready for the moment the archer chooses.

decisions.choice: my words
decisions.reason: Readable says what the mouth stands for here: the servant's speech.

decisions.choice: the case that holds arrows
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word "quiver".

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖י עַבְדִּי־אָ֑תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר־בְּךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, my servant [are] you, Israel, whom in you I will show my beauty.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "My servant [are] you, Israel, \q in whom I will display {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty."
en.B: He said to me, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, Israel; \q in you I will make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty known."
en.R: He told me, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, Israel. \q Through you people will see how wonderful I am."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me dijo: «Mi siervo [eres] tú, Israel, \q en quien mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermosura».
es.B: Me dijo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, Israel; \q en ti daré a conocer {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermosura».
es.R: Me dijo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, Israel. \q Por medio de ti la gente verá lo maravilloso que soy».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dit : « Tu [es] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, Israël, \q en qui je montrerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} beauté. »
fr.B: Il m’a dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, Israël ; \q en toi je ferai connaître {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur. »
fr.R: Il m’a dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, Israël. \q Grâce à toi, les gens verront combien je suis merveilleux. »

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [ni] wewe, Israeli, \q ambaye katika wewe nitaonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: Aliniambia, "Wewe ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Israeli; \q ndani yako nitaufanya uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ujulikane."
sw.R: Aliniambia, "Wewe ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Israeli. \q Kupitia wewe watu wataona jinsi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilivyo wa ajabu."

decisions.choice: my servant, Israel: the servant bears the people's name, yet verses 5-6 send him to restore that people
alternatives: an individual who fulfills Israel's calling
decisions.reason: The servant who speaks in 49:1-6 is called Israel here, as the people are in 41:8-9 (see the note at 41:8). Yet in verses 5-6 he is sent to bring Jacob back and to gather Israel, so he is in some way distinct from the nation as a whole. The passage holds both together. It has been read of the nation in its true calling, of a faithful individual who does what Israel was called to do, and of the prophet himself. The New Testament takes up verse 6 for Jesus as a light for the nations (Luke 2:32) and for the apostles' mission (Acts 13:47). The name stays as written, and the translation does not choose among these readings.

decisions.choice: Israel: kept, as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The name stands in the Masoretic Text, in the Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) and in the Septuagint (from memory; to be checked). One medieval Hebrew manuscript leaves it out (from memory; to be checked), which would leave the servant unnamed. That single late witness is too weak to set aside the rest.

decisions.choice: I will display my beauty: I will be glorified, show my splendor
decisions.reason: The verb means to show oneself beautiful or to win honor. Isaiah uses it of what God does through redeemed Israel (44:23; 60:21; 61:3).

decisions.choice: people will see how wonderful I am
decisions.reason: Readable supplies "people" as those who see God's beauty shown through the servant.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ לְרִ֣יק יָגַ֔עְתִּי לְתֹ֥הוּ וְהֶ֖בֶל כֹּחִ֣י כִלֵּ֑יתִי אָכֵן֙ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה וּפְעֻלָּתִ֖י אֶת־אֱלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, I said, for emptiness I have labored, for nothingness and vapor my strength I have used up; surely my justice [is] with Yahweh, and my wage with my God.

en.L: And I, I said, "For emptiness I have toiled; \q for nothing and vapor I have spent my strength. \q Surely my justice [is] with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and my wage with my God."
en.B: But I said, "I have toiled for no purpose; \q I have worn out my strength for what is empty, a mere breath. \q Even so, my case rests with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and my God holds my wages."
en.R: But I said, "My hard work has been useless. \q I have used up all my strength, and it was for nothing. \q Yet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will judge my case fairly. \q My God will pay me what I have earned."

es.L: Pero yo dije: «En vano me he afanado; \q para nada y vanidad he gastado mis fuerzas. \q Ciertamente mi derecho [está] con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y mi salario con mi Dios».
es.B: Pero yo dije: «He trabajado sin propósito alguno; \q he agotado mis fuerzas en lo que está vacío, en un mero soplo. \q Aun así, mi causa está en manos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y mi Dios guarda mi recompensa».
es.R: Pero yo dije: «Todo mi duro trabajo ha sido inútil. \q He gastado todas mis fuerzas, y fue para nada. \q Sin embargo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará mi caso con justicia. \q Mi Dios me pagará lo que he ganado».

fr.L: Et moi, j’ai dit : « C’est pour le vide que j’ai peiné ; \q pour le néant et la vapeur j’ai épuisé ma force. \q Pourtant mon droit [est] auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et mon salaire auprès de mon Dieu. »
fr.B: Mais moi, je disais : « J’ai peiné pour rien ; \q j’ai usé mes forces pour du vide, pour un simple souffle. \q Pourtant ma cause est entre les mains {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et mon Dieu tient en réserve mon salaire. »
fr.R: Mais moi, j’ai dit : « Mon travail n’a servi à rien. \q J’ai dépensé toutes mes forces, et c’était pour rien. \q Pourtant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera ma cause avec justice. \q Mon Dieu me donnera ce que j’ai mérité. »

sw.L: Nami nilisema, "Nimejitaabisha bure; \q kwa ajili ya utupu na mvuke nimezimaliza nguvu zangu. \q Hakika hukumu yangu [iko] kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na ujira wangu kwa Mungu wangu."
sw.B: Lakini nilisema, "Nimetaabika bila faida; \q nimezimaliza nguvu zangu kwa kitu kisicho na maana, pumzi tu. \q Hata hivyo, shauri langu liko mikononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na Mungu wangu ndiye anayeshika ujira wangu."
sw.R: Lakini nilisema, "Kazi yangu ngumu imekuwa bure. \q Nimetumia nguvu zangu zote, na ilikuwa bure. \q Hata hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahukumu shauri langu kwa haki. \q Mungu wangu atanilipa ninachostahili."

decisions.choice: and I, I said: the servant's lament set against God's words
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed. God has just promised glory through the servant (verse 3); the servant answers with what his work has looked like to him, and then turns to trust.

decisions.choice: emptiness, nothing and vapor: work that seems to come to nothing
decisions.reason: The words are strong. The middle one is the formless emptiness of Genesis 1:2 (also 40:17, 23), and the last is breath or vapor, the word of Ecclesiastes 1:2. The servant's labor seemed to leave nothing behind.

decisions.choice: my justice and my wage: the just outcome of my case, and the pay due me
decisions.reason: The word for justice here means the verdict a person is owed. Beside "wage" it says that the LORD will see that the servant receives what is right. The same pair, reward and wages, is said of God in 40:10 and 62:11.

decisions.choice: will judge my case fairly; will pay me what I have earned
decisions.reason: Readable turns "my justice is with the LORD, and my wage with my God" into what those words promise.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יֹצְרִ֤י מִבֶּ֨טֶן֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד ל֔וֹ לְשׁוֹבֵ֤ב יַֽעֲקֹב֙ אֵלָ֔יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ל֣וֹ יֵאָסֵ֑ף וְאֶכָּבֵד֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וֵאלֹהַ֖י הָיָ֥ה עֻזִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now says Yahweh, forming me from [the] womb to [be] a servant to him, to bring back Jacob to him, and Israel to him will be gathered, and I am honored in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and my God has been my strength,

en.L: And now says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who formed me from the womb to be a servant to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q to bring Jacob back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and Israel will be gathered to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q and I am honored in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and my God has become my strength,
en.B: And now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} speaks, who shaped me in the womb to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, \q to turn Jacob back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and to gather Israel to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q (for I am honored in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and my God has become my strength),
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} formed me before I was born to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant. \q He made me to bring the people of Jacob back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to gather Israel to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} honors me, and my God is my strength. \q And now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} speaks.

es.L: Y ahora dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que me formó desde el vientre para ser siervo {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}, \q para hacer volver a Jacob hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q e Israel será reunido a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q y soy honrado a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y mi Dios ha sido mi fuerza,
es.B: Y ahora habla {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que me formó en el vientre para ser {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, \q para hacer que Jacob vuelva a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q y reunir a Israel en torno a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q (porque soy honrado a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y mi Dios ha llegado a ser mi fuerza),
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me formó antes de que yo naciera para ser {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo. \q Me hizo para traer de vuelta hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} al pueblo de Jacob y para reunir a Israel en torno a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me honra, y mi Dios es mi fuerza. \q Y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habla.

fr.L: Et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit, lui qui m’a formé dès le sein [maternel] pour être {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \q pour ramener Jacob vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et Israël sera rassemblé vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q et je suis honoré aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et mon Dieu est devenu ma force,
fr.B: Et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parle, lui qui m’a façonné dans le sein maternel pour être {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \q pour ramener Jacob vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et pour rassembler Israël auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q (car je suis honoré aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et mon Dieu est devenu ma force),
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a formé avant ma naissance pour que je sois {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur. \q Il m’a fait pour ramener vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le peuple de Jacob et pour rassembler Israël auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’honore, et mon Dieu est ma force. \q Et maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parle.

sw.L: Na sasa asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeniumba tangu tumboni niwe mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kumrudisha Yakobo {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, \q na Israeli atakusanywa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}; \q nami ninaheshimiwa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na Mungu wangu amekuwa nguvu yangu,
sw.B: Na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema, yeye aliyenifinyanga tumboni niwe mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q ili kumrudisha Yakobo {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} \q na kumkusanya Israeli {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} \q (kwa maana ninaheshimiwa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na Mungu wangu amekuwa nguvu yangu),
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniumba kabla sijazaliwa ili niwe mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Aliniumba ili niwarudishe watu wa Yakobo {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} na kumkusanya Israeli {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananiheshimu, na Mungu wangu ndiye nguvu yangu. \q Na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema.

decisions.choice: Israel will be gathered to him: the reading marked for reading aloud
decisions.reason: The consonants as written read "not", which gives "and Israel is not gathered" or "so that Israel may not be swept away". The scribes' reading for reading aloud is "to him", which sounds the same. "To him" fits the parallel with "to bring Jacob back to him", and the Great Isaiah Scroll has it (from memory; to be checked).

decisions.choice: to bring Jacob back to him: the servant has a mission to Israel
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring back, both home from exile and back to God. A servant who is sent to Israel is in some way distinct from Israel as a whole (see verse 3).

decisions.choice: and I am honored ... and my God has become my strength: an aside
decisions.reason: These two lines interrupt the sentence that begins "And now the LORD says". They answer the lament of verse 4, and the sentence picks up again in verse 6 with "he says".

decisions.choice: And now the LORD speaks (placed last)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the description of the servant first in short sentences and ends with "now the LORD speaks", which leads into his words in verse 6.

decisions.choice: the people of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Jacob here is the people descended from him.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָקֵ֨ל מִֽהְיוֹתְךָ֥ לִי֙ עֶ֔בֶד לְהָקִים֙ אֶת־שִׁבְטֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּנְצוּרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהָשִׁ֑יב וּנְתַתִּ֨יךָ֙ לְא֣וֹר גּוֹיִ֔ם לִֽהְי֥וֹת יְשׁוּעָתִ֖י עַד־קְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and he says, it is [too] light, for your being my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and the preserved of Israel to bring back; and I will make you into a light of nations to be my salvation to [the] end of the earth.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "[It] is too light [a thing] for you to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant \q to raise up the tribes of Jacob \q and to bring back the preserved of Israel; \q and I will make you a light of [the] nations, \q to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation to the end of the earth."
en.B: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says: "It is not enough that you should be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant \q to raise up the tribes of Jacob \q and bring home the survivors of Israel. \q I will make you a light for the nations as well, \q so that you may be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation to the farthest edge of the earth."
en.R: He says, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant. \q But bringing back the tribes of Jacob and the people of Israel I kept safe is not enough work for you. \q I will also make you a light for the nations. \q You will bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation to the farthest places on earth."

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice: «Poca cosa [es] que tú seas {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo \q para levantar las tribus de Jacob \q y hacer volver a los preservados de Israel; \q también te pondré por luz de las naciones, \q para que seas {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación hasta el confín de la tierra».
es.B: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice: «No basta con que seas {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo \q para restaurar las tribus de Jacob \q y hacer volver a los sobrevivientes de Israel. \q También te pondré como luz para las naciones, \q para que seas {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación hasta el lugar más lejano de la tierra».
es.R: Él dice: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo. \q Pero traer de vuelta a las tribus de Jacob y al pueblo de Israel que yo protegí no es trabajo suficiente para ti. \q También te pondré como luz para las naciones. \q Llevarás {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación hasta los lugares más lejanos de la tierra».

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « C’est trop peu que tu sois {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur \q pour relever les tribus de Jacob \q et pour ramener les préservés d’Israël ; \q je ferai de toi la lumière des nations, \q pour être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre. »
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Il ne suffit pas que tu sois {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur \q pour relever les tribus de Jacob \q et ramener les survivants d’Israël. \q Je ferai aussi de toi la lumière des nations, \q pour que tu sois {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre. »
fr.R: Il dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur. \q Mais ramener les tribus de Jacob et les gens d’Israël que j’ai protégés, ce n’est pas assez de travail pour toi. \q Je ferai aussi de toi une lumière pour les nations. \q Tu apporteras {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre. »

sw.L: naye asema, "Ni jambo jepesi mno wewe kuwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q kuziinua kabila za Yakobo \q na kuwarudisha waliohifadhiwa wa Israeli; \q nami nitakufanya nuru ya mataifa, \q ili uwe wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hadi mwisho wa dunia."
sw.B: anasema: "Haitoshi wewe kuwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q ili kuziinua kabila za Yakobo \q na kuwarudisha nyumbani walionusurika wa Israeli. \q Nitakufanya pia uwe nuru kwa mataifa, \q ili uwe wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hadi miisho ya mbali ya dunia."
sw.R: Anasema, "Wewe ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Lakini kuwarudisha watu wa kabila za Yakobo na watu wa Israeli niliowalinda si kazi ya kutosha kwako. \q Nitakufanya pia uwe nuru kwa mataifa. \q Utaupeleka wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hadi mahali pa mbali kabisa duniani."

decisions.choice: a light for the nations
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats 42:6. Simeon echoes it of the child Jesus (Luke 2:32). Paul and Barnabas quote this verse to explain their turn to the Gentiles (Acts 13:47), and Paul refers to it again in Acts 26:23.

decisions.choice: to be my salvation: the servant himself is how God's salvation reaches the end of the earth
alternatives: so that my salvation may reach the end of the earth
decisions.reason: The words can be read of the servant ("that you may be my salvation") or of the result ("so that my salvation may reach"). The first follows the grammar more closely and agrees with Acts 13:47, which, following the Greek translation, says "that you may be for salvation to the end of the earth". Either way God's salvation is to reach every land.

decisions.choice: the preserved of Israel: the survivors whom God has kept
decisions.reason: The word means those kept or guarded, the remnant that survived (1:9; 10:20-22). The written consonants and the reading aloud differ only by one vowel letter of the same word.

decisions.choice: as well; also
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the two clauses with "and"; Balanced and Readable say "as well" and "also" because the first task is called too slight, so the second is added to it.

decisions.choice: You will bring my salvation
decisions.reason: Readable says what it means for the servant to be God's salvation to the end of the earth.

decisions.choice: luz de / para las naciones; hasta el confín de la tierra
decisions.reason: Acts 13:47 quotes this line; Spanish keeps the key words of the published verse ("luz de las naciones", "hasta el confín de la tierra" at Literal, "luz para las naciones" at Balanced) so the quotation can be recognized.

decisions.choice: nuru ya mataifa; hadi mwisho wa dunia
decisions.reason: Acts 13:47 quotes this line; "nuru" and "mwisho wa dunia" keep its key words, as Luke 2:32 keeps "nuru" for 42:6.

decisions.choice: "la lumière des nations ... jusqu'à l'extrémité de la terre"
alternatives: "la lumière des peuples ... jusqu'au bout du monde"
decisions.reason: Acts 13:47 quotes this line; French keeps the published key words at every level so the quotation can be seen.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְהוָה֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קְדוֹשׁ֗וֹ לִבְזֹה־נֶ֜פֶשׁ לִמְתָ֤עֵֽב גּוֹי֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד מֹשְׁלִ֔ים מְלָכִים֙ יִרְא֣וּ וָקָ֔מוּ שָׂרִ֖ים וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֑וּלְמַ֤עַן יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶאֱמָ֔ן קְדֹ֥שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּבְחָרֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh, [the] redeemer of Israel, its Holy One, to [one] despised of soul, to [one] abhorred of nation, to a servant of rulers: kings will see and rise, princes, and they will bow down, because of Yahweh who [is] faithful, [the] Holy One of Israel, and he has chosen you.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Redeemer of Israel, its Holy One, to [one] despised of soul, to [one] abhorred by [the] nation, to a servant of rulers: \q Kings will see and stand up, \q princes, and they will bow down, \q because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who [is] faithful, \q the Holy One of Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the Redeemer of Israel and its Holy One, says this to the one whom everyone despises, whom the nation detests, the servant of rulers: \q Kings will see you and rise to their feet; \q princes will see you and bow low, \q because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who keeps faith, \q the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. He is Israel's Redeemer, its Holy One. He speaks to the one whom people hate, the one the nation despises, the one who serves rulers: \q Kings will see you and stand up to honor you. \q Princes will see you and bow down. \q They will do this because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises. \q The Holy One of Israel has chosen you.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Redentor de Israel, su Santo, al despreciado de alma, al aborrecido por la nación, al siervo de los gobernantes: \q Reyes verán y se levantarán, \q príncipes, y se postrarán, \q a causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que [es] fiel, \q del Santo de Israel, que te ha escogido.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Redentor de Israel y su Santo, dice esto al que todos desprecian, al que la nación aborrece, al siervo de los gobernantes: \q Los reyes te verán y se pondrán de pie; \q los príncipes te verán y se inclinarán, \q a causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que cumple su palabra, \q del Santo de Israel, que te ha escogido.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Él es el Redentor de Israel, su Santo. Le habla al que la gente odia, al que la nación desprecia, al que sirve a los gobernantes: \q Los reyes te verán y se pondrán de pie para honrarte. \q Los príncipes te verán y se inclinarán. \q Harán esto porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cumple {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas. \q El Santo de Israel te ha escogido.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Rédempteur d’Israël, son Saint, à celui dont on méprise l’âme, à celui que la nation abhorre, au serviteur des tyrans : \q Des rois verront et se lèveront, \q des princes, et ils se prosterneront, \q à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui [est] fidèle, \q du Saint d’Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a choisi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Libérateur d’Israël et son Saint, dit ceci à celui que tout le monde méprise, que la nation déteste, au serviteur des puissants : \q Des rois te verront et se lèveront ; \q des princes te verront et se prosterneront, \q à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui tient parole, \q du Saint d’Israël, qui t’a choisi.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui délivre Israël, le Saint d’Israël. Il parle à celui que les gens détestent, à celui que la nation méprise, à celui qui sert les chefs : \q Des rois te verront et se lèveront pour t’honorer. \q Des princes te verront et se prosterneront. \q Ils le feront parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses. \q Le Saint d’Israël t’a choisi.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi, Mkombozi wa Israeli, Mtakatifu wake, kwa [yeye] aliyedharauliwa na watu, kwa [yeye] anayechukiwa na taifa, kwa mtumishi wa watawala: \q Wafalme wataona na kusimama, \q wakuu, nao watasujudu, \q kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliye mwaminifu, \q Mtakatifu wa Israeli, naye amekuchagua.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo, Mkombozi wa Israeli na Mtakatifu wake, kwa yule ambaye kila mtu anamdharau, ambaye taifa linamchukia, mtumishi wa watawala: \q Wafalme watakuona na kusimama; \q wakuu watakuona na kusujudu, \q kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayeshika ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q Mtakatifu wa Israeli, aliyekuchagua.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema. Yeye ni Mkombozi wa Israeli, Mtakatifu wake. Anamwambia yule ambaye watu wanamchukia, yule ambaye taifa linamdharau, yule anayewatumikia watawala: \q Wafalme watakuona na kusimama ili kukuheshimu. \q Wakuu watakuona na kusujudu. \q Watafanya hivyo kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hutimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Mtakatifu wa Israeli amekuchagua.

decisions.choice: despised of soul: deeply despised, held in contempt by people
alternatives: one whose life is held cheap
decisions.reason: The word often translated "soul" can mean the self, a person, or a life. The phrase can mean one despised to the core, one whom people despise, or one whose life is held cheap. Each describes deep contempt; 53:3 uses the same word "despised" twice of the servant.

decisions.choice: abhorred by the nation, a servant of rulers: rejected and kept under foreign power
decisions.reason: "Nation" is singular. It may mean Israel, or the nations taken together. "Servant of rulers" describes one subject to foreign masters, as Israel was in exile.

decisions.choice: kings will rise and princes bow: the despised one honored because God is faithful
decisions.reason: The ones who held him in contempt will stand and bow. The reason is God's faithfulness to the one he chose, not anything in the servant's outward state. The same reversal returns in 49:23 and 52:13-15.

decisions.choice: stand up to honor you
decisions.reason: Readable explains why the kings rise: to show respect.

decisions.choice: keeps his promises
decisions.reason: Readable explains "faithful" as keeping one's word.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה בְּעֵ֤ת רָצוֹן֙ עֲנִיתִ֔יךָ וּבְי֥וֹם יְשׁוּעָ֖ה עֲזַרְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶצָּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֙ לִבְרִ֣ית עָ֔ם לְהָקִ֣ים אֶ֔רֶץ לְהַנְחִ֖יל נְחָל֥וֹת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: in a time of favor I have answered you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you; and I will keep you and I will give you for a covenant of [the] people, to raise up [the] land, to cause to inherit desolate inheritances,

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: In a time of favor I have answered you, \q and in a day of salvation I have helped you; \q and I will keep you and give you as a covenant of [the] people, \q to raise up [the] land, \q to apportion desolate inheritances,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: In a time of favor I answered you; \q on the day of salvation I came to your aid. \q I will watch over you and give you to be a covenant for the people, \q to set the land on its feet again \q and to hand out once more its ruined estates,
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: When the time came for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to show kindness, I answered you. \q When the day came for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to save, I helped you. \q I will protect you. I will make you a covenant for the people. \q You will rebuild the land \q and give the ruined family lands back to the people.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: En tiempo de favor te he respondido, \q y en día de salvación te he ayudado; \q y te guardaré y te daré como pacto del pueblo, \q para levantar la tierra, \q para repartir las heredades asoladas,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: En tiempo de favor te respondí; \q en el día de salvación vine en tu ayuda. \q Te protegeré y te daré como pacto para el pueblo, \q para poner otra vez en pie la tierra \q y repartir de nuevo sus heredades en ruinas,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Cuando llegó el tiempo de mostrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} bondad, te respondí. \q Cuando llegó el día de salvar, te ayudé. \q Te protegeré. Te haré un pacto para el pueblo. \q Reconstruirás la tierra \q y devolverás al pueblo las tierras de sus familias que estaban en ruinas.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Au temps de la faveur je t’ai répondu, \q et au jour du salut je t’ai aidé ; \q et je te garderai et je te donnerai comme alliance du peuple, \q pour relever le pays, \q pour faire hériter les héritages dévastés,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Au temps de la faveur, je t’ai répondu ; \q au jour du salut, je suis venu à ton secours. \q Je veillerai sur toi et je ferai de toi l’alliance du peuple, \q pour remettre le pays sur pied \q et redistribuer ses domaines dévastés,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Quand le moment est venu pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de montrer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bonté, je t’ai répondu. \q Quand le jour est venu pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de sauver, je t’ai aidé. \q Je te protégerai. Je ferai de toi une alliance pour le peuple. \q Tu reconstruiras le pays \q et tu rendras au peuple les terres de famille qui étaient en ruine.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Wakati wa kibali nimekujibu, \q na siku ya wokovu nimekusaidia; \q nami nitakulinda na kukutoa uwe agano la watu, \q kuiinua nchi, \q kugawa urithi uliokuwa ukiwa,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Wakati wa kibali nilikujibu; \q siku ya wokovu nilikuja kukusaidia. \q Nitakulinda na kukutoa uwe agano kwa ajili ya watu, \q kuisimamisha nchi tena \q na kugawa upya mashamba yake yaliyoharibiwa,
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Wakati ulipofika wa kuonyesha fadhili {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, nilikujibu. \q Siku ilipofika ya kuokoa, nilikusaidia. \q Nitakulinda. Nitakufanya uwe agano kwa ajili ya watu. \q Utaijenga nchi upya \q na kuwarudishia watu mashamba ya jamaa zao yaliyoharibiwa.

decisions.choice: a time of favor, a day of salvation
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 2 Corinthians 6:2, from the Greek translation, and adds, "now is the day of salvation". "Favor" is God's goodwill; 61:2 speaks of the year of the LORD's favor.

decisions.choice: I have answered you, I have helped you: what God has already settled
decisions.reason: The first two verbs are in the form for completed action, then the verbs change to the future ("I will keep you"). God speaks of his answer as already given; the help is certain. "You" is the servant of verses 1-6, and "a covenant of the people" repeats 42:6 (see the note there).

decisions.choice: raise up the land, apportion the desolate inheritances: restore the land and give the family plots back
decisions.reason: An inheritance is a family's share of the land. Giving out inheritances recalls Joshua dividing the land among the tribes (Joshua 13-19), and the return of family land in the year of jubilee (Leviticus 25:10).

decisions.choice: the time came for me to show kindness
decisions.reason: Readable explains "a time of favor" as the time God chose to show his goodwill.

decisions.choice: give the ruined family lands back to the people
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the inheritances are family lands and supplies who receives them.

decisions.choice: en tiempo de favor; en día de salvación
decisions.reason: 2 Corinthians 6:2 quotes this line ("En tiempo de favor te respondí; en el día de salvación vine en tu ayuda" at Balanced); Spanish keeps those key words here.

decisions.choice: wakati wa kibali; siku ya wokovu
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 2 Corinthians 6:2, where the published Swahili Literal says "wakati wa kibali" and "siku ya wokovu"; the same key words are kept here.

source.text: לֵאמֹ֤ר לַֽאֲסוּרִים֙ צֵ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּחֹ֖שֶׁךְ הִגָּל֑וּ עַל־דְּרָכִ֣ים יִרְע֔וּ וּבְכָל־שְׁפָיִ֖ים מַרְעִיתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: to say to [the] prisoners, go out; to [those] who [are] in darkness, show yourselves. On [the] roads they will graze, and on all bare heights [will be] their pasture.

en.L: to say to the prisoners, "Go out," \q to those who [are] in darkness, "Show yourselves." \q On [the] roads they will graze, \q and on all bare heights [will be] their pasture.
en.B: telling the prisoners, "Go free," \q and those in the dark, "Come out into the open." \q They will graze along the roads, \q and every bare hilltop will be their grazing land.
en.R: You will tell the prisoners, "Come out!" \q You will tell those who sit in the dark, "Come out where you can be seen!" \q Like sheep, they will find food along the roads \q and on the bare hills.

es.L: para decir a los presos: «{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}}», \q a los que [están] en tinieblas: «{{plural_you:Muéstrense|Mostraos}}». \q Junto a los caminos pacerán, \q y en todas las alturas desnudas [estarán] sus pastos.
es.B: para decir a los presos: «{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} libres», \q y a los que están en la oscuridad: «{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} a la luz». \q Pastarán a lo largo de los caminos, \q y toda colina pelada será su pastizal.
es.R: Les dirás a los presos: «¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}}!». \q Les dirás a los que están sentados en la oscuridad: «¡{{plural_you:Salgan donde se les pueda|Salid donde se os pueda}} ver!». \q Como ovejas, encontrarán comida junto a los caminos \q y en las colinas peladas.

fr.L: pour dire aux prisonniers : « Sortez », \q à ceux qui [sont] dans les ténèbres : « Montrez-vous. » \q Sur les chemins ils paîtront, \q et sur toutes les hauteurs dénudées [sera] leur pâturage.
fr.B: pour dire aux prisonniers : « Soyez libres », \q et à ceux qui sont dans l’obscurité : « Sortez au grand jour. » \q Ils paîtront le long des routes, \q et chaque colline nue sera leur pâturage.
fr.R: Tu diras aux prisonniers : « Sortez ! » \q Tu diras à ceux qui sont assis dans le noir : « Venez là où l’on peut vous voir ! » \q Comme des moutons, ils trouveront de quoi manger le long des routes \q et sur les collines nues.

sw.L: kuwaambia wafungwa, "Tokeni," \q wale walio gizani, "Jitokezeni." \q Kando ya njia watalisha, \q na juu ya vilele vyote vilivyo wazi [kutakuwa] malisho yao.
sw.B: ukiwaambia wafungwa, "Tokeni huru," \q na walio gizani, "Njooni nje mwonekane." \q Watalisha kando ya barabara, \q na kila kilima kilicho wazi kitakuwa mahali pao pa malisho.
sw.R: Utawaambia wafungwa, "Tokeni!" \q Utawaambia wale wanaoketi gizani, "Njooni mahali mnapoweza kuonekana!" \q Kama kondoo, watapata chakula kando ya barabara \q na juu ya vilima vilivyo wazi.

decisions.choice: prisoners in darkness: the exiles, pictured as captives in a dungeon
decisions.reason: Exile is described as prison and darkness in 42:7 and 42:22. Release from prison and darkness returns in 61:1, the passage Jesus reads in Luke 4:18.

decisions.choice: they will graze: the freed people are a flock fed on the way home
decisions.reason: The returning exiles are pictured as sheep with a shepherd (40:11). Even bare heights, where nothing grows, give them pasture (41:18).

decisions.choice: You will tell
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and supplies the subject, the servant addressed in verse 8.

decisions.choice: Like sheep
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture of a flock explicit.

source.text: לֹ֤א יִרְעָ֨בוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִצְמָ֔אוּ וְלֹא־יַכֵּ֥ם שָׁרָ֖ב וָשָׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּי־מְרַחֲמָ֣ם יְנַהֲגֵ֔ם וְעַל־מַבּ֥וּעֵי מַ֖יִם יְנַהֲלֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not they will hunger, and not they will thirst, and not will strike them burning heat and sun; for [one] having compassion on them will guide them, and to springs of water he will lead them.

en.L: They will not hunger, and they will not thirst, \q and burning heat and sun will not strike them; \q for the one who has compassion on them will guide them, \q and to springs of water {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will lead them.
en.B: They will not go hungry or thirsty, \q and neither the searing heat nor the sun will beat them down, \q for the one who has mercy on them will be their guide; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bring them to springs of water.
en.R: They will not be hungry or thirsty. \q The hot desert wind and the sun will not hurt them. \q The one who loves them will lead them. \q He will take them to springs of water.

es.L: No tendrán hambre ni tendrán sed, \q ni los herirá el calor abrasador ni el sol; \q porque el que tiene compasión de ellos los guiará, \q y a manantiales de agua {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los conducirá.
es.B: No pasarán hambre ni sed, \q ni el calor abrasador ni el sol los abatirá, \q porque el que tiene misericordia de ellos será su guía; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los llevará a manantiales de agua.
es.R: No tendrán hambre ni sed. \q El viento caliente del desierto y el sol no les harán daño. \q El que los ama los guiará. \q Él los llevará a manantiales de agua.

fr.L: Ils n’auront pas faim, et ils n’auront pas soif, \q et la chaleur brûlante et le soleil ne les frapperont pas ; \q car celui qui a compassion d’eux les guidera, \q et vers des sources d’eau {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les conduira.
fr.B: Ils ne souffriront ni de la faim ni de la soif, \q ni la chaleur brûlante ni le soleil ne les accableront, \q car celui qui a pitié d’eux sera leur guide ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les mènera vers des sources d’eau.
fr.R: Ils n’auront ni faim ni soif. \q Le vent brûlant du désert et le soleil ne leur feront pas de mal. \q Celui qui les aime les conduira. \q Il les emmènera vers des sources d’eau.

sw.L: Hawataona njaa, wala hawataona kiu, \q wala joto kali na jua halitawapiga; \q kwa maana yeye awahurumiaye atawaongoza, \q na kwenye chemchemi za maji atawaelekeza.
sw.B: Hawatakuwa na njaa wala kiu, \q wala joto linalounguza wala jua halitawapiga, \q kwa maana yule anayewaonea huruma atakuwa kiongozi wao; \q atawafikisha kwenye chemchemi za maji.
sw.R: Hawatakuwa na njaa wala kiu. \q Upepo wa joto wa jangwani na jua havitawadhuru. \q Yule anayewapenda atawaongoza. \q Atawapeleka kwenye chemchemi za maji.

decisions.choice: burning heat: the scorching heat of the desert
decisions.reason: The word appears elsewhere only in 35:7, where it may mean the burning sand or the shimmering mirage of the desert. Here, beside "sun", it is the heat that strikes travelers.

decisions.choice: no hunger, thirst or burning sun; springs of water
decisions.reason: Revelation 7:16-17 takes up these words for those who come out of great distress. Psalm 121:6 and Psalm 23:2 use similar pictures of God's care.

decisions.choice: the one who has compassion on them: God himself
decisions.reason: The verb is the tender love of a parent for a child; verse 15 uses it of a mother. God is named by what he feels for his people.

decisions.choice: the hot desert wind
decisions.reason: Readable uses a familiar picture for the desert's scorching heat.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י כָל־הָרַ֖י לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וּמְסִלֹּתַ֖י יְרֻמֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make all my mountains into a road, and my highways will be raised.

en.L: And I will make all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains into a road, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} highways will be raised up.
en.B: Every one of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains I will turn into a pathway, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} main roads will be built up high.
en.R: All {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains will become a road. \q I will build {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} highways up high.

es.L: Y convertiré todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes en camino, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} calzadas serán levantadas.
es.B: Cada uno de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes lo convertiré en sendero, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} calzadas serán elevadas.
es.R: Todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes se convertirán en un camino. \q Construiré en alto {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} calzadas.

fr.L: Et je ferai de toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} montagnes un chemin, \q et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} routes seront élevées.
fr.B: De chacune de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} montagnes je ferai un sentier, \q et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} grandes routes seront surélevées.
fr.R: Toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} montagnes deviendront une route. \q Je construirai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} grandes routes bien en hauteur.

sw.L: Nami nitaifanya milima {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote kuwa njia, \q na barabara {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu zitainuliwa.
sw.B: Kila mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} nitaugeuza kuwa njia, \q na barabara {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu zitajengwa juu.
sw.R: Milima {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote itakuwa barabara. \q Nitazijenga barabara {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu juu.

decisions.choice: a road through the mountains: the way home made ready
decisions.reason: This is the highway of 40:3-4, where every mountain is brought low, and of 35:8, 11:16 and 62:10. The mountains are "mine" because God made them and rules them.

decisions.choice: my highways will be raised: built up as raised roadways
decisions.reason: A highway was a road built up above the ground around it, smooth and easy to travel.

decisions.choice: I will build my highways up high
decisions.reason: Readable makes God the subject of the second line, since he is the one who builds the road.

source.text: הִנֵּה־אֵ֕לֶּה מֵרָח֖וֹק יָבֹ֑אוּ וְהִֽנֵּה־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִצָּפ֣וֹן וּמִיָּ֔ם וְאֵ֖לֶּה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ סִינִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Here! these from afar will come, and here! these from [the] north and from [the] west, and these from [the] land of Sinim.

en.L: Look! These will come from afar, \q and look! these from [the] north and from [the] sea, \q and these from [the] land of Sinim.
en.B: Look, they are coming from far away; \q look, some from the north and from the west, \q and some from the land of Sinim.
en.R: Look! People will come from places far away. \q Some will come from the north and some from the west. \q Others will come from the land of Sinim.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! Estos vendrán de lejos, \q ¡y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}! estos del norte y del mar, \q y estos de la tierra de Sinim.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, vienen de lejos; \q {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, unos del norte y del occidente, \q y otros de la tierra de Sinim.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! Vendrá gente de lugares lejanos. \q Unos vendrán del norte y otros del occidente. \q Otros vendrán de la tierra de Sinim.

fr.L: Voici, ceux-ci viendront de loin, \q et voici, ceux-là du nord et de la mer, \q et ceux-ci du pays de Sinim.
fr.B: Voyez, ils viennent de loin ; \q voyez, les uns du nord et de l’ouest, \q et d’autres du pays de Sinim.
fr.R: Regardez ! Des gens viendront d’endroits très lointains. \q Certains viendront du nord, et d’autres de l’ouest. \q D’autres encore viendront du pays de Sinim.

sw.L: Tazama! Hawa watakuja kutoka mbali, \q na tazama! hawa kutoka kaskazini na kutoka baharini, \q na hawa kutoka nchi ya Sinimu.
sw.B: Tazama, wanakuja kutoka mbali; \q tazama, wengine kutoka kaskazini na kutoka magharibi, \q na wengine kutoka nchi ya Sinimu.
sw.R: Tazama! Watu watakuja kutoka mahali pa mbali. \q Wengine watakuja kutoka kaskazini na wengine kutoka magharibi. \q Wengine watakuja kutoka nchi ya Sinimu.

decisions.choice: from the sea: from the west
decisions.reason: The Mediterranean lies west of Israel, so "the sea" is the usual word for the west (Genesis 28:14).

decisions.choice: the land of Sinim: a far-off land, not certainly identified
decisions.reason: The name occurs only here. The Great Isaiah Scroll reads "of the Syenites" (from memory; to be checked), the people of Syene, modern Aswan on Egypt's southern border (Ezekiel 29:10; 30:6). The name is kept as it stands in the Masoretic Text.

decisions.choice: Sinimu
decisions.reason: The unknown land is given a Swahili ending, as Hebrew names are (Kedari, Nebayothi).

source.text: רָנּ֤וּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְגִ֣ילִי אָ֔רֶץ וּפִצְח֥וּ הָרִ֖ים רִנָּ֑ה כִּֽי־נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וַעֲנִיָּ֖ו יְרַחֵֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Shout for joy, heavens, and rejoice, earth, and break forth, mountains, [into] a shout of joy; for Yahweh has comforted his people, and his afflicted ones he will have compassion on.

en.L: Shout for joy, heavens, and rejoice, earth, \q and break out, mountains, [into] a shout of joy! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has comforted {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q and on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} afflicted ones {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will have compassion.
en.B: Heavens, ring out with joy! Earth, be glad! \q Mountains, break out in cries of joy! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has comforted {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people \q and will show tender love to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} suffering ones.
en.R: Heavens, shout for joy! Earth, be happy! \q Mountains, sing out loud! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has comforted {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q He will be kind to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are suffering.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} de júbilo, cielos, y alégrate, tierra, \q y {{plural_you:prorrumpan|prorrumpid}}, montes, [en] gritos de júbilo! \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha consolado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \q y de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} afligidos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tendrá compasión.
es.B: ¡Cielos, {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría! ¡Tierra, alégrate! \q ¡Montes, {{plural_you:estallen|estallad}} en gritos de júbilo! \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha consolado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo \q y mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierno amor a los que sufren.
es.R: ¡Cielos, {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría! ¡Tierra, ponte feliz! \q ¡Montes, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} en voz alta! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha consolado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Él será bondadoso con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que sufre.

fr.L: Criez de joie, cieux, et réjouis-toi, terre, \q et éclatez, montagnes, [en] cris de joie ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q et de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} affligés {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura compassion.
fr.B: Cieux, éclatez de joie ! Terre, sois dans l’allégresse ! \q Montagnes, faites éclater des cris de joie ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montrera un amour plein de tendresse à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} malheureux.
fr.R: Ciel, crie de joie ! Terre, sois heureuse ! \q Montagnes, chantez très fort ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a consolé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Il sera bon pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui souffre.

sw.L: Imbeni kwa furaha, enyi mbingu, na ufurahi, ee dunia, \q na pazeni [sauti ya] shangwe, enyi milima! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewafariji watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na wanyonge {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atawahurumia.
sw.B: Enyi mbingu, pigeni vigelegele! Ee dunia, furahi! \q Enyi milima, pazeni sauti za shangwe! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewafariji watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} \q na atawaonyesha upendo mwororo wanaoteseka {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Enyi mbingu, pigeni kelele za furaha! Ee dunia, furahi! \q Enyi milima, imbeni kwa sauti kubwa! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewafariji watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Atawatendea wema watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wanaoteseka.

decisions.choice: and break out: a command, as read aloud
decisions.reason: The consonants as written give "let them break out"; the reading for reading aloud is the command "and break out". The meaning is the same: the mountains are called to shout.

decisions.choice: the LORD has comforted his people
decisions.reason: This answers the call of 40:1, "Comfort my people", and 52:9 repeats the line. Heaven, earth and mountains are called to sing in the same way in 44:23.

decisions.choice: his afflicted ones: his people, poor and brought low
decisions.reason: The word means those who are humbled and in need. The verb is the same word for tender love as in verses 10 and 15.

decisions.choice: will be kind to
decisions.reason: Readable uses a simple word for God's tender love.

source.text: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר צִיּ֖וֹן עֲזָבַ֣נִי יְהוָ֑ה וַאדֹנָ֖י שְׁכֵחָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Zion, has forsaken me Yahweh, and [the] Lord has forgotten me.

en.L: But Zion said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has forsaken me, \q and the Lord has forgotten me."
en.B: But Zion said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has left me behind; \q the Lord has forgotten all about me."
en.R: But Zion, the city of Jerusalem, said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has left me. \q The Lord has forgotten me."

es.L: Pero Sion dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha abandonado, \q y el Señor se ha olvidado de mí».
es.B: Pero Sion dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dejado atrás; \q el Señor se ha olvidado por completo de mí».
es.R: Pero Sion, la ciudad de Jerusalén, dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dejado. \q El Señor se ha olvidado de mí».

fr.L: Mais Sion a dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a abandonnée, \q et le Seigneur m’a oubliée. »
fr.B: Mais Sion disait : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a délaissée ; \q le Seigneur m’a complètement oubliée. »
fr.R: Mais Sion, la ville de Jérusalem, a dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a quittée. \q Le Seigneur m’a oubliée. »

sw.L: Lakini Sayuni alisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameniacha, \q na Bwana amenisahau."
sw.B: Lakini Sayuni alisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameniacha nyuma; \q Bwana amenisahau kabisa."
sw.R: Lakini Sayuni, yaani mji wa Yerusalemu, ulisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameniacha. \q Bwana amenisahau."

decisions.choice: Zion: Jerusalem, pictured as a woman who has lost her children
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the chapter God speaks to Zion as a mother whose children were taken from her (verses 15-21). Her complaint is like Jacob's in 40:27 and the prayer of Lamentations 5:20.

decisions.choice: the Lord: the title meaning master
decisions.reason: Zion uses God's name and then his title as master; both lines say the same thing.

decisions.choice: the city of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable explains that Zion is Jerusalem, which speaks as a person.

source.text: הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ עוּלָ֔הּ מֵרַחֵ֖ם בֶּן־בִּטְנָ֑הּ גַּם־אֵ֣לֶּה תִשְׁכַּ֔חְנָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶשְׁכָּחֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will forget a woman her nursing child, from having compassion on [the] son of her womb? Even these may forget, and I, I will not forget you.

en.L: Will a woman forget her nursing infant, \q [so as to be] without compassion for the son of her womb? \q Even these may forget, \q but I, I will not forget you.
en.B: Could a woman forget the baby she is nursing, \q or stop feeling tender love for the son she carried? \q Women such as these may forget, \q but I will not forget you.
en.R: Can a mother forget the baby she is feeding? \q Can she stop caring about the son she gave birth to? \q A mother might forget, \q but I will never forget you.

es.L: ¿Se olvidará una mujer de su niño de pecho, \q [para dejar de] compadecerse del hijo de su vientre? \q Aunque estas se olviden, \q yo, yo no me olvidaré de ti.
es.B: ¿Podría una mujer olvidarse del bebé que amamanta, \q o dejar de sentir tierno amor por el hijo que llevó en su vientre? \q Aun si mujeres como estas se olvidaran, \q yo no me olvidaré de ti.
es.R: ¿Puede una madre olvidarse del bebé al que le da el pecho? \q ¿Puede dejar de amar al hijo que dio a luz? \q Una madre podría olvidar, \q pero yo nunca me olvidaré de ti.

fr.L: Une femme oubliera-t-elle son nourrisson, \q [au point de n’avoir] pas de compassion pour le fils de son ventre ? \q Même celles-ci peuvent oublier, \q mais moi, je ne t’oublierai pas.
fr.B: Une femme peut-elle oublier le bébé qu’elle allaite, \q cesser d’avoir de la tendresse pour le fils qu’elle a porté ? \q Même si de telles femmes oubliaient, \q moi, je ne t’oublierai pas.
fr.R: Une mère peut-elle oublier le bébé qu’elle nourrit ? \q Peut-elle cesser d’aimer le fils qu’elle a mis au monde ? \q Une mère pourrait oublier, \q mais moi, je ne t’oublierai jamais.

sw.L: Je, mwanamke atamsahau mtoto wake anayenyonya, \q [hata] asimhurumie mwana wa tumbo lake? \q Hata hawa wanaweza kusahau, \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitakusahau.
sw.B: Je, mwanamke anaweza kumsahau mtoto anayemnyonyesha, \q au kuacha kumwonea huruma mwana aliyembeba tumboni? \q Wanawake kama hao wanaweza kusahau, \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitakusahau.
sw.R: Je, mama anaweza kumsahau mtoto anayemnyonyesha? \q Je, anaweza kuacha kumjali mwana aliyemzaa? \q Mama anaweza kusahau, \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitakusahau kamwe.

decisions.choice: compassion for the son of her womb: a mother's love for the child of her body
decisions.reason: The verb for tender love and the noun for womb come from the same root, so the line ties a mother's love to her body. It is the same verb used of God in verses 10 and 13.

decisions.choice: even these may forget: granting what seems impossible
decisions.reason: "These" are women such as the nursing mother. God allows, for the sake of argument, that a mother might forget, and then says he never will.

decisions.choice: I will not forget you: God's love is surer than a mother's
decisions.reason: Isaiah compares God to a mother also in 66:13; Psalm 27:10 says that even if father and mother forsake, the LORD will take one in.

source.text: הֵ֥ן עַל־כַּפַּ֖יִם חַקֹּתִ֑יךְ חוֹמֹתַ֥יִךְ נֶגְדִּ֖י תָּמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: Here! on palms I have engraved you; your walls [are] before me continually.

en.L: See, on [the] palms I have engraved you; \q your walls [are] before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} continually.
en.B: Look, I have carved you into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} palms; \q your walls are never out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.
en.R: Look, I have carved you into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands so that I cannot forget you. \q I always see your walls.

es.L: Mira, en las palmas [de mis manos] te tengo grabada; \q tus muros [están] delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} continuamente.
es.B: Mira, te he grabado en las palmas de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos; \q tus muros nunca se apartan de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista.
es.R: Mira, te he grabado en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos para no olvidarte. \q Siempre veo tus muros.

fr.L: Voici, sur les paumes je t’ai gravée ; \q tes murailles [sont] continuellement devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Vois, je t’ai gravée dans les paumes de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains ; \q tes murailles ne quittent jamais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux.
fr.R: Regarde, je t’ai gravée dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains pour ne pas pouvoir t’oublier. \q Je vois toujours tes murailles.

sw.L: Tazama, katika viganja nimekuchora; \q kuta zako [ziko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} daima.
sw.B: Tazama, nimekuchora katika viganja vya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q kuta zako hazitoki machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} kamwe.
sw.R: Tazama, nimekuchora katika mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ili nisiweze kukusahau. \q Ninaziona kuta zako siku zote.

decisions.choice: engraved on the palms: a lasting mark that is always in view
decisions.reason: The verb is used for cutting letters into a hard surface (Job 19:23-24). A mark on the hand is seen whenever the hand is used; compare 44:5, where people write "The LORD's" on their hand, and the names of the tribes the high priest wore before God (Exodus 28:9-12, 21). The palms are God's, as the context shows.

decisions.choice: your walls: Jerusalem's walls, now broken down, always in God's mind
decisions.reason: The walls may be the ruined walls God still sees, or the plan for rebuilding them, as if drawn on his hands.

decisions.choice: so that I cannot forget you
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the picture, which answers Zion's complaint in verse 14.

source.text: מִֽהֲר֖וּ בָּנָ֑יִךְ מְהָֽרְסַ֥יִךְ וּמַחֲרִבַ֖יִךְ מִמֵּ֥ךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They have hurried, your children; [those] tearing you down and [those] laying you waste from you will go out.

en.L: Your children hurry; \q those who tear you down and those who lay you waste will go out from you.
en.B: Your children are hurrying home, \q while those who wrecked you and stripped you bare are leaving you.
en.R: Your children are rushing back home to you. \q The people who tore you down and destroyed you are leaving.

es.L: Tus hijos se apresuran; \q los que te destruyen y los que te asolan saldrán de ti.
es.B: Tus hijos vuelven a toda prisa, \q mientras los que te derribaron y te dejaron desolada se van de ti.
es.R: Tus hijos regresan corriendo a casa contigo. \q La gente que te derribó y te destruyó se está yendo.

fr.L: Tes fils se hâtent ; \q ceux qui te démolissaient et ceux qui te dévastaient sortiront de chez toi.
fr.B: Tes enfants se hâtent de rentrer, \q tandis que ceux qui t’ont démolie et dévastée s’en vont.
fr.R: Tes enfants se dépêchent de rentrer chez toi. \q Les gens qui t’ont démolie et détruite s’en vont.

sw.L: Watoto wako wanafanya haraka; \q wale wanaokubomoa na wale wanaokufanya ukiwa watatoka kwako.
sw.B: Watoto wako wanaharakisha kurudi nyumbani, \q nao wale waliokuharibu na kukuacha tupu wanaondoka kwako.
sw.R: Watoto wako wanakimbia kurudi nyumbani kwako. \q Watu waliokubomoa na kukuharibu wanaondoka.

decisions.choice: your children: as in the Masoretic Text
decisions.reason: The Great Isaiah Scroll reads "your builders" (from memory; to be checked). In Hebrew the two words have the same consonants and differ only in vowels, and "builders" makes a pair with "those who tear you down". The children's return is the theme of verses 18-23, so the Masoretic reading is kept.

decisions.choice: home
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add where the children are hurrying, which verse 18 makes plain.

source.text: שְׂאִֽי־סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֨יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־לָ֑ךְ חַי־אָ֣נִי נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י כֻלָּם֙ כָּעֲדִ֣י תִלְבָּ֔שִׁי וּֽתְקַשְּׁרִ֖ים כַּכַּלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up around your eyes and see; all of them have gathered, they have come to you. [As] I live, declaration of Yahweh, for all of them like ornament you will put on, and you will bind them on like a bride.

en.L: Lift up your eyes all around and see: \q all of them have gathered; they have come to you. \q [As] I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all of them you will put on like an ornament, \q and you will bind them on like a bride.
en.B: Raise your eyes and look in every direction: \q they are all gathering and coming to you. \q As I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you will put every one of them on like jewelry \q and wrap them about you like a bride on her wedding day.
en.R: Look up and look all around you. \q All your children are gathering and coming to you. \q I promise you by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own life, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q they will make you beautiful, like the jewels a bride wears.

es.L: Alza tus ojos alrededor y mira: \q todos ellos se han reunido; han venido a ti. \q Vivo yo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que de todos ellos te vestirás como de adorno, \q y te los ceñirás como una novia.
es.B: Levanta la vista y mira a tu alrededor: \q todos se reúnen y vienen a ti. \q Tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que te los pondrás todos como joyas \q y te los ceñirás como una novia el día de su boda.
es.R: Levanta la mirada y mira a tu alrededor. \q Todos tus hijos se están reuniendo y vienen a ti. \q Te lo prometo por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia vida, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q ellos te harán hermosa, como las joyas que lleva una novia.

fr.L: Lève les yeux tout autour et regarde : \q tous se sont rassemblés ; ils sont venus vers toi. \q [Aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous, tu les revêtiras comme une parure, \q et tu les attacheras [sur toi] comme une fiancée.
fr.B: Lève les yeux et regarde de tous côtés : \q ils se rassemblent tous et viennent vers toi. \q Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tu te pareras de chacun d’eux comme d’un bijou, \q tu les porteras autour de toi comme une mariée le jour de ses noces.
fr.R: Lève les yeux et regarde tout autour de toi. \q Tous tes enfants se rassemblent et viennent vers toi. \q Je te le promets sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} propre vie, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q ils te rendront belle, comme les bijoux que porte une mariée.

sw.L: Inua macho yako pande zote uone: \q wote wamekusanyika; wamekuja kwako. \q [Kama] niishivyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wote hao utawavaa kama pambo, \q nawe utawafunga kama bibi arusi.
sw.B: Inua macho yako utazame kila upande: \q wote wanakusanyika na kuja kwako. \q Kwa uhai {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utawavaa wote kama vito \q na kujifunga nao kama bibi arusi siku ya arusi yake.
sw.R: Tazama juu, uangalie pande zote. \q Watoto wako wote wanakusanyika na kuja kwako. \q Ninakuahidi kwa uhai {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: \q watakufanya uwe mzuri, kama vito anavyovaa bibi arusi.

decisions.choice: as I live: an oath by God's own life
decisions.reason: God swears by himself because there is no one greater (45:23; Numbers 14:21). The oath makes the promise certain.

decisions.choice: you will put them on like ornaments, like a bride: the returning children are Zion's beauty
decisions.reason: Zion, who thought herself bereaved, will wear her children as a bride wears her jewels. The bride picture returns in 61:10 and 62:5.

decisions.choice: I promise you by my own life
decisions.reason: Readable explains the form of the oath.

source.text: כִּ֤י חָרְבֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ וְשֹׁ֣מְמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְאֶ֖רֶץ הֲרִֽסֻתֵ֑יךְ כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ תֵּצְרִ֣י מִיּוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְרָחֲק֖וּ מְבַלְּעָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For your ruins and your desolate [places] and [the] land of your destruction, for now you will be [too] cramped for [the] inhabitants, and far away will be [those] swallowing you.

en.L: For your ruins and your desolate places \q and your land of destruction, \q surely now you will be too cramped for [the] inhabitants, \q and those who swallowed you will be far away.
en.B: Your ruins and your abandoned places, \q your devastated land, \q will now be too crowded for the people who live in them, \q and those who devoured you will be long gone.
en.R: Your land was ruined and empty. \q But now it will be too small for all the people who live there. \q And the enemies who swallowed you up will be far away.

es.L: Porque tus ruinas y tus lugares desolados \q y tu tierra destruida, \q ciertamente ahora serás demasiado estrecha para los habitantes, \q y los que te devoraban estarán lejos.
es.B: Tus ruinas y tus lugares abandonados, \q tu tierra devastada, \q ahora serán demasiado estrechos para los que vivan en ellos, \q y los que te devoraron estarán muy lejos.
es.R: Tu tierra estaba arruinada y vacía. \q Pero ahora será demasiado pequeña para toda la gente que vivirá allí. \q Y los enemigos que te tragaron estarán lejos.

fr.L: Car tes ruines et tes lieux dévastés \q et ton pays détruit, \q oui, maintenant tu seras trop étroite pour les habitants, \q et ceux qui t’engloutissaient seront loin.
fr.B: Tes ruines et tes lieux abandonnés, \q ton pays dévasté, \q seront maintenant trop petits pour ceux qui y habitent, \q et ceux qui te dévoraient seront partis depuis longtemps.
fr.R: Ton pays était en ruine et vide. \q Mais maintenant, il sera trop petit pour tous les gens qui y habitent. \q Et les ennemis qui t’avaient avalée seront loin.

sw.L: Kwa maana magofu yako na mahali pako palipo ukiwa \q na nchi yako ya uharibifu, \q hakika sasa utakuwa mwembamba mno kwa wakaaji, \q na wale waliokumeza watakuwa mbali.
sw.B: Magofu yako na mahali pako palipoachwa, \q nchi yako iliyoharibiwa, \q sasa patakuwa padogo mno kwa watu wanaoishi humo, \q na wale waliokula wewe watakuwa wameondoka mbali.
sw.R: Nchi yako ilikuwa imeharibiwa na kuachwa tupu. \q Lakini sasa itakuwa ndogo mno kwa watu wote wanaoishi huko. \q Na adui waliokumeza watakuwa mbali.

decisions.choice: for your ruins ... for now: a sentence broken off and begun again
decisions.reason: The verse begins with Zion's ruins, leaves that line hanging, and starts again with "for now". The break shows the excitement of the promise; the sense is that the ruined land will be crowded with people.

decisions.choice: those who swallowed you: enemies pictured as devouring beasts
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 51:34 uses the same picture of Babylon swallowing Jerusalem like a monster.

source.text: ע֚וֹד יֹאמְר֣וּ בְאָזְנַ֔יִךְ בְּנֵ֖י שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִךְ צַר־לִ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם גְּשָׁה־לִּ֥י וְאֵשֵֽׁבָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Yet will say in your ears the children of your bereavement: [too] cramped for me [is] the place; draw near for me, so I may dwell.

en.L: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your ears, \q "Too cramped for me [is] the place; move over for me, that I may settle."
en.B: The children born while you were mourning your losses will still say in your hearing, \q "There is not enough room here for me; move aside so I can have a place to live."
en.R: The children born after you lost your other children will say to you, \q "There is no room for me here! Move over so I can live here."

es.L: Aún dirán a tus oídos los hijos de tu orfandad: \q «Estrecho [es] para mí el lugar; hazme sitio para que habite».
es.B: Los hijos que nacieron mientras llorabas tus pérdidas todavía dirán a tus oídos: \q «Aquí no hay sitio para mí; hazte a un lado para que yo tenga dónde vivir».
es.R: Los hijos que nacieron después de que perdiste a tus otros hijos te dirán: \q «¡Aquí no hay sitio para mí! Hazte a un lado para que yo pueda vivir aquí».

fr.L: Ils diront encore à tes oreilles, les fils de ton deuil : \q « Trop étroit pour moi [est] le lieu ; fais-moi de la place, pour que je m’installe. »
fr.B: Les enfants nés pendant que tu pleurais tes pertes te diront encore : \q « Il n’y a pas assez de place ici pour moi ; pousse-toi pour que je puisse m’installer. »
fr.R: Les enfants nés après que tu as perdu tes autres enfants te diront : \q « Il n’y a pas de place pour moi ici ! Pousse-toi pour que je puisse habiter ici. »

sw.L: Bado watoto wa kufiwa kwako watasema masikioni mwako, \q "Mahali [hapa] ni pembamba mno kwangu; nisogelee, ili nikae."
sw.B: Watoto waliozaliwa ulipokuwa ukiomboleza hasara zako bado watasema ukiwasikia, \q "Hakuna nafasi ya kutosha kwangu hapa; sogea kando nipate mahali pa kuishi."
sw.R: Watoto waliozaliwa baada ya kupoteza watoto wako wengine watakuambia, \q "Hakuna nafasi yangu hapa! Sogea ili nipate kuishi hapa."

decisions.choice: children of your bereavement: children born to Zion after she lost her children
decisions.reason: The noun means the loss of one's children. These are the children Zion has after that loss, whom she does not expect (verse 21). Some take them as the lost children themselves, coming back.

decisions.choice: draw near for me: move closer, make room
decisions.reason: The verb means to come near; with "for me" it asks others to press closer to leave room.

source.text: וְאָמַ֣רְתְּ בִּלְבָבֵ֗ךְ מִ֤י יָֽלַד־לִי֙ אֶת־אֵ֔לֶּה וַאֲנִ֥י שְׁכוּלָ֖ה וְגַלְמוּדָ֑ה גֹּלָ֣ה׀וְסוּרָ֗ה וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִ֣י גִדֵּ֔ל הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה אֵיפֹ֥ה הֵֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will say in your heart, who bore for me these? And I [was] bereaved and barren, exiled and turned aside; and these, who brought up? Here! I, I was left by myself; these, where [were] they?

en.L: And you will say in your heart, "Who has fathered these for me? \q I was bereaved and barren, \q exiled and turned away; and these, who brought [them] up? \q See, I was left by myself; \q these, where [were] they?"
en.B: Then you will ask yourself, "Who fathered these children for me? \q I had lost my children and could bear no more; \q I was exiled and cast aside. Who raised these? \q I was left all by myself; \q where have these been?"
en.R: Then you will think, "Who gave me all these children? \q My children were taken from me, and I could not have more. \q I was taken away from my home and pushed aside. Who raised these children? \q I was left all alone. \q So where have these children been?"

es.L: Y dirás en tu corazón: «¿Quién me ha engendrado a estos? \q Yo estaba sin hijos y estéril, \q desterrada y apartada; y a estos, ¿quién [los] crio? \q Mira, yo había quedado sola; \q estos, ¿dónde [estaban]?».
es.B: Entonces te preguntarás: «¿Quién me ha dado estos hijos? \q Yo había perdido a mis hijos y no podía tener más; \q estaba desterrada y desechada. ¿Quién crio a estos? \q Me había quedado completamente sola; \q ¿dónde estaban estos?».
es.R: Entonces pensarás: «¿Quién me dio todos estos hijos? \q Me quitaron a mis hijos, y no podía tener más. \q Me sacaron de mi hogar y me hicieron a un lado. ¿Quién crio a estos hijos? \q Me quedé completamente sola. \q Entonces, ¿dónde han estado estos hijos?».

fr.L: Et tu diras dans ton cœur : « Qui m’a engendré ceux-ci ? \q J’étais privée d’enfants et stérile, \q exilée et repoussée ; et ceux-ci, qui [les] a élevés ? \q Voici, j’étais restée seule ; \q ceux-ci, où [étaient]-ils ? »
fr.B: Alors tu te demanderas : « Qui m’a donné ces enfants ? \q J’avais perdu mes enfants et je ne pouvais plus en avoir ; \q j’étais exilée et rejetée. Qui a élevé ceux-ci ? \q J’étais restée toute seule ; \q où étaient-ils donc ? »
fr.R: Alors tu penseras : « Qui m’a donné tous ces enfants ? \q On m’avait pris mes enfants, et je ne pouvais plus en avoir. \q On m’avait emmenée loin de chez moi et mise de côté. Qui a élevé ces enfants ? \q J’étais restée toute seule. \q Alors, où étaient ces enfants ? »

sw.L: Nawe utasema moyoni mwako, "Ni nani aliyenizalia hawa? \q Nilikuwa nimefiwa na tasa, \q mhamishwa na kufukuzwa; na hawa, ni nani aliyewalea? \q Tazama, niliachwa peke yangu; \q hawa, walikuwa wapi?"
sw.B: Ndipo utajiuliza, "Ni nani aliyenizalia watoto hawa? \q Nilikuwa nimepoteza watoto wangu, wala sikuweza kuzaa tena; \q nilikuwa uhamishoni na kutupwa kando. Ni nani aliyewalea hawa? \q Niliachwa peke yangu kabisa; \q hawa wamekuwa wapi?"
sw.R: Kisha utawaza, "Ni nani aliyenipa watoto hawa wote? \q Watoto wangu walichukuliwa kutoka kwangu, wala sikuweza kupata wengine. \q Nilichukuliwa kutoka nyumbani kwangu na kusukumwa kando. Ni nani aliyewalea watoto hawa? \q Niliachwa peke yangu kabisa. \q Basi watoto hawa walikuwa wapi?"

decisions.choice: who has fathered these for me: Zion cannot account for her children
